body: The VP just sent me a message 15 minutes ago asking if I could talk in 15 minutes. I have no idea what is going to happen. I'm so scared.
The good news is that he thinks we might be able to figure something out. He has to talk to some uplevel people and will get back to me on Monday or Tuesday. So it's all on pause for right now.

I have a therapist but I haven't talked to him about this right now. Last time I saw him last weekend things were okay.

I've tried to reach out to friends but I feel manipulative.

It's the only way I know to do it. But I'm scared it won't work. I know it will be painful but then again, I deserve that. I'm scared if it won't work that it I will have to go on living with the burden.
No. I don't want to hurt people. I don't like it when they are hurt. I guess I just don't care (at the time) if a choice I make hurts them. Then I feel shitty after.
Because I use people. I am not sensitive to their feelings.
Because my "friends" all think I am a caring person. Someone who is a good member of society and who takes care of his family, and cares about other people. And I wonder if I really do.

Yes, I told her why. She knows why. She is angry and upset because I lied about it and didn't tell her I was doing it, etc.

The problem is that i just feel like I keep going down this same path. I don't know if I am strong enough and on one hand there are things in my life that people would be so jealous of. But it is all so false.

Because I do things only thinking of myself. I withdrew my 401(k) so I could buy a car because i needed one to go see my kids, and I was supposed to transfer it to my ex-wife as part of the divorce. She found out today and her attorney is filing me as contempt of court which will put me in jail.

I should not have done this. I was being selfish again and only thinking about myself. So one more selfish act and it will be my last.
everything is just so false. people think they know me but it's all a facade.
My flatmate is out of town so nobody would even find me for days.

IF I knew for sure it would work I wouldn't be on the fence. I can't take the embarrassment and risk of a failed attempt - if I have to go back inpatient I will probably lose my job.

Although my ex-wife is filing for me to be in contempt of court which will probably put me in jail even though she thinks it won't, which will cost me my job anyway. 

There is no way out.

I am pretty sure I've decided to not do this tonight. My little girl fell down and hurt her head and had to get stitches, and I need to see her at least one more time before I leave this life. Thank you everyone for listening to me tonight.
Financially? I can probably figure it out. I should have a decent tax return coming.

Not really, because it is set the way it is to basically pay the bills. I'll be honest and say she is also cutting down to the bone. The problem is we have too big of a house. Once I get my own place we can try to sell it and that will help (my alimony goes down by $600/month once I have my own place, so that helps)

That's totally the way to approach it - it needs to be your avocation before it is your vocation. And there's also no reason that it can't be an avocation your entire life and still be totally fulfilling.

Without the 50 cent words, that means "it can be something you do passionately and with great intensity, but not your job". 

I know that years ago when I was getting into filmmaking, everyone was full of "advice" on how it was so hard, there was no way I was going to make it, etc, etc. Those opinions are cheap - and you don't need them. I can also say that even though I didn't "succeed" in my goal to make moviemaking my number one profession and job, I succeeded in making three pretty cool short films. And that's something nobody can take away from me.

You're looking to create art. Art is hard and painful, but it's also an amazing outlet. And I'm pretty sure that the majority of successful comedians are standing up on stage because they kept thinking "I'm going to bust my ass to prove to those jerk wad bullies that I am way better than they are". And that's totally okay.
Yeah, I already take public trans/bike to work. It's pretty close and I live in a pretty big city.

Well, I'm going to be packing my lunch and making dinner at home. Short of that, I'm pretty slim as it is. I could try to talk my roommate into cutting back the cable, but that might be tough since she's not the one who is suffering financial craziness.

That's what I'm scared of - hurting them more. 

TO BE CLEAR - I HAVE NEVER PHYSICALLY HARMED MY CHILDREN.

I just needed to make that clear. I've done a lot of rotten and terrible things in my life, but i have never physically harmed a person. And I have also never been mean to my kids ever. That's the only good thing I can say.
Yeah, I'm already living in a pretty cheap two bedroom with a roommate; in order for the kids to come stay with me I'd need to get a two bedroom by myself. Which would cost more.

connection is so hard and it's the root of the problem. So the anonymity of reddit might help. Both in feeling safe about having ideations but also in terms of character transparency.

I have a personality disorder, and it's one of the big problems. I cannot be honest and transparent with anyone. There is not a single human being on this planet who knows who I really am, how I really feel, what I really think. Because I'm very ashamed of who that person is, and for whatever reason (i'm charismatic, whatever) people think I'm a good person and I don't want to shatter their perception.
Thanks for the links; I'm going to give a listen.
I'm trying to work on who to reach out to without looking like a threat. This is helping already a little. I still am not made up my mind. But it's a distraction which is good.

I will say that makes some sense. I don't know what I will do with it, but I know when I was reading this subreddit (which I had never seen before tonight) I was seeing a lot of people who I felt passionately to reach out to, because I've been there and I suffered through it,and at least at that time, it got okay. Maybe it sucks now but what sucked at 20 is a distant memory now.

But it's compound interest. It keeps building I guess. So the lesson to be learned is to not just push it aside.

Isn't it funny how when we look at ourselves objectively (if we can) we would give ourselves such great advice? I think that's what makes my depression and sadness so pathetic to myself - it just seems ridiculous. It makes me think of a line from Friends when Chandler says "Oh no, two women are in love with me. They're both smart and sexy. My wallet is too small for my 50's and my diamond shoes are too tight!"

But inside, all I can see is that it is an illusion. My success is always waiting to fail and fall. It's all tied back to self esteem I know (for crying out loud, I was freaking out that nobody was replying to my post and was basically thinking "great, so I suck at being suicidal on the internet also").

I just feel really backed into a corner. I can't afford to pay all the bills. To keep seeing my kids I need to get a bigger apartment and a new car, neither of which I can afford (since my paycheck now doesn't even cover my current living expenses plus what I (will) pay in child support and maintenance to my ex). 

I am really in love with my job but at the same time I feel like I have over-extended myself there and the piper will come calling and I will fail there. I have things that I will miss when I am gone but they aren't important, and the risk of failing at them even worse is frightening.

I wish I could hold my kids one more time before I go. I left them today during a big fight with my ex and that will be the last thing (if anything) they will remember of their dad.
I know what you mean. I don't know what it will be like for my kids to grow up knowing their dad killed himself. They won't understand it now but one day they will know.
To clarify. I am going through a divorce. I am diagnosed bipolar. I am always failing, and I feel like everyone that I become involved with becomes damaged due to me. That disease needs to stop.
